summary: CICS online Card Update screen. The user retrieves a card (by account + card number), edits its embossed name, active status and expiry month/year, and saves. Runs field validations (account, card, name, card status, expiry month, expiry year), compares old vs new, and rewrites the card record only if it changed and was not modified by another user since it was read (optimistic concurrency). Pseudo-conversational via a 2000-byte COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the card-update screen. On re-entry evaluate the key and program state (PF3 exit; Enter process/edit; confirm to update) via DECIDE-ACTION; read the card, validate edits, and on confirmation commit the update. Return to CICS with the COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the map and run the field-edit suite.

paragraphs.name: 1100-RECEIVE-MAP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the card-update map from the terminal.

paragraphs.name: 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate all card fields: account, card number, embossed name, card status, expiry month and expiry year; set an overall error flag.

paragraphs.name: 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the account number is present, numeric and a valid 11-digit account id.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: account number must be valid (11 numeric digits).

paragraphs.name: 1220-EDIT-CARD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the card number is present, numeric and 16 digits.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: card number must be a valid 16-digit number.

paragraphs.name: 1230-EDIT-NAME
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the embossed card name is present and contains only allowed (alphabetic/space) characters.
branches: IF blank or invalid chars -> error

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: embossed name must be present and alphabetic.

paragraphs.name: 1240-EDIT-CARDSTATUS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the card active status is a valid value (Y/N active flag).

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: card status must be a valid active flag (Y/N).

paragraphs.name: 1250-EDIT-EXPIRY-MON
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the expiry month is numeric and in the range 01-12.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: expiry month must be 01-12.

paragraphs.name: 1260-EDIT-EXPIRY-YEAR
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the expiry year is numeric and within an acceptable range.
branches: IF year out of range -> error

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: expiry year must be numeric and within a valid range (confirm bounds with SME).

paragraphs.name: 2000-DECIDE-ACTION
paragraphs.pseudocode: Decide the next step from program state and edit results: prompt for card, show fetched values, confirm changes, or perform the update.

paragraphs.name: 3000-SEND-MAP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build and send the card-update map (init, set variables, info message, attributes, transmit).

paragraphs.name: 3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the map fields with the current card values (as fetched or as edited).

paragraphs.name: 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Set field attributes/protection and cursor for the current state.

paragraphs.name: 9000-READ-DATA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the card record by account+card key and snapshot it as the original baseline for change/concurrency checking.

paragraphs.name: 9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the card record by the account+card composite key (CICS READ); on not-found set an error.

paragraphs.name: 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING
paragraphs.pseudocode: Commit the update: re-read the card for update, verify it has not changed since it was displayed, and if unchanged rewrite the card record with the edited name/status/expiry; otherwise report a concurrent-change error.
branches: IF changed since read -> concurrency error

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: card update applied only if the record was not changed by another user since it was read (optimistic concurrency).

paragraphs.notes: BUSINESS-CRITICAL: card update with concurrency control.

paragraphs.name: 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC
paragraphs.pseudocode: Compare the re-read card against the baseline snapshot to detect concurrent modification.

paragraphs.name: COMMON-RETURN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Save state and CICS RETURN with the transaction id.

paragraphs.name: ABEND-ROUTINE
paragraphs.pseudocode: On unrecoverable error, display an abend message and terminate the transaction.
